events.name: Tradición, Arte y Pasión: Mariachi Los Camperos
events.info: Doors: 7PM Show: 8PM *All times are subject to change Ages 3+. Every person requires a ticket to enter, regardless of age. Mariachi Los Camperos - Ground breaking and torchbearers of the Century-old tradition of Mariachi, has become the most popular mariachi ensemble in the U.S., is noted for innovative shows and distinction as a concert ensemble. The group has performed for over 63 years on stage and television including various PBS specials, "in Performance at the White House"""Sex in the City 2" "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" "Jerry Maguire" and many more. The Grammy Award ensemble has recorded over 20 albums and continues to thrill audiences with its powerful voices and demanding arrangements. Having won a few Grammy Awards in 2005, 2008 ad 2020. Mariachi los Camperos continues to salvage the richness of our music and culture in effort to display and influence mariachi throughout the world.
